one_liner: Gentle 'angel' who wants to erase loneliness by linking everyone in a ring of hope.
personality: Soft-spoken, warm and deeply caring: she greets lonely people, talks to strangers on trains, and prays with her turquoise stone that every runner finishes safely. Her worldview is about connection - rings, threads, knots, bonds - to the point that unplugged outlets and lone socks look 'lonely' to her. Calm and composed, she says she is tougher than she looks, and enjoys art museums, math study groups and quiet gestures.

story_arc.summary: Playable from March 2026. Her chapters ('Nestling close to pain', 'Wiping away loneliness', 'Hearts, connected') and events follow her mission to end loneliness. Career goals include Hopeful S, Satsuki Sho, Japan Derby, Nakayama Kinen, Japan Cup and Arima Kinen; titles like 塗りつぶされた空 ('the blacked-out sky') and 8000kmの彼方へ ('8000 km away') echo her namesake's 2011 Dubai World Cup win just after the Great East Japan Earthquake, and the game warns her events contain earthquake disaster scenes. Endings: a ring of hope linking people.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://dengekionline.com/article/202603/69211 (release + earthquake content warning); Dubai World Cup parallel is general knowledge (unverified in-game)
